Container.Name: Argus
Container.Overview: PRTG-style monitoring cockpit layered on Zabbix: site->host->sensor tree, per-sensor graphs, acknowledge/pause/hide, cross-site problem overview, and Discord/Telegram/email notifications with 2h trend graphs. Single distroless container; state (SQLite + encryption keyfile) lives on the /data volume.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Argus web UI (container listens on 8080).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database + at-rest encryption keyfile. Persist this.

Config.Name: Zabbix API URL
Config.Description: Zabbix JSON-RPC endpoint.

Config.Name: Zabbix API Token
Config.Description: Zabbix API token (Bearer). Needs write scope for acknowledge/pause.

Config.Name: Admin Email (first run)
Config.Description: Seeds the initial admin only while the user table is empty; ignored afterwards.

Config.Name: Admin Password (first run)
Config.Description: Password for the seeded admin. Remove after first run.

Config.Name: Cookie Secure (HTTPS)
Config.Description: Set true when served over HTTPS (Secure session cookie).

Config.Name: Secret Key (at-rest encryption)
Config.Description: Encrypts stored secrets (channel creds, TOTP, signing key). Use e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`. Keep it STABLE - changing it makes existing encrypted values unreadable. Empty = auto keyfile on /data (weaker).

Config.Name: Trust Proxy
Config.Description: Read client IP from X-Forwarded-For for rate limiting. Set true behind a reverse proxy (ensure it sends XFF).

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: External base URL, used for Open/Acknowledge links in notifications.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone for notification timestamps.

Config.Name: CA (probe enrollment)
Config.Description: Folder holding ca.crt + ca.key (from gen-certs.sh). Mounted read-only; enables the Probes -> Add probe wizard. Leave the enrollment fields blank to keep enrollment off.

Config.Name: CA cert file
Config.Description: Path to the CA certificate inside the container (set only if you mounted the CA above).

Config.Name: CA key file
Config.Description: Path to the CA private key inside the container. Needed to sign probe certs.

Config.Name: Probe core host
Config.Description: Address probes dial for :10051 (FQDN that publishes 10051, or LAN IP). Defaults to the Public URL host.

Config.Name: Login Max Attempts
Config.Description: Failed logins per window before throttling.

Config.Name: Login Window (minutes)
Config.Description: Rate-limit sliding window.

Config.Name: Passkey RP ID
Config.Description: WebAuthn relying-party ID = the FQDN, no scheme. Needs HTTPS + real domain; omit for plain HTTP/IP.

Config.Name: Passkey Display Name
Config.Description: Name shown by the authenticator.

Config.Name: Passkey Origins
Config.Description: Comma-separated origins, e.g. https://monitoring.example.com
